title: C-3PO
description: C-3PO is a protocol droid who is fluent in more than six million galactic languages, including the electronic language of his squat sidekick, R2-D2. Threepio is something of a fuss-budget, always complaining of the scrapes his droid companion has gotten them into. After following Artoo to Tatooine, Threepio is purchased by Luke Skywalker and begins a frightening adventure. Along the way, he is disassembled and nearly melted down.
